headlines.title: Russian finance minister, invited by Trump, draws objections at G-20 meeting
headlines.summary: As Moscow pounds Ukraine, the appearance by Finance Minister Anton Siluanov was “quite troubling,” said one attendee. U.S. officials cited a need for “dialogue.”

headlines.title: Trump vows to hit Iran hard as strikes and economic pressure ramp up
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump said that the United States, which had transitioned largely to economic warfare, would respond militarily to the Iranian attack on Jordan.

headlines.title: Soccer great Lionel Messi announces retirement from Argentina’s national team
headlines.summary: “There isn’t much time left, and different chapters are coming to an end. This is one that hurts me a lot,” the 2022 World Cup winner wrote on Instagram.

headlines.title: Trust drives Sino-Kyrgyz cooperation, envoy says
headlines.summary: Political trust and regular high-level exchanges have created favorable conditions for Kyrgyzstan and China to deepen practical cooperation in transport, trade, energy and emerging technologies, said Aktilek Musaeva, the ambassador of Kyrgyzstan to China.

For the tourists, this introduction by the Chinese-speaking tour guide is a delightfully memorable icebreaker.
